objective: Make background DSH goal rounds auditable in agent-relay: every round appends a durable ledger record, stop conditions are evaluated by code instead of by memory, and the runbook documents how to read both.

tasks.title: round ledger: append-only, one record per round, replay-safe
tasks.acceptance: tools/continuation/round_guard.mjs records a round as {roundId, at, planDigest, gates, outcome}; recording the same roundId twice changes nothing and returns duplicate; node test_t095b158_round_guard.mjs green

tasks.title: stop conditions evaluated by code, not by memory
tasks.acceptance: evaluateStop() returns blocked when the same gate failed twice in a row, stop_and_report when a round's scope is outside the plan, done when the task list is exhausted, continue otherwise; each code covered by a test

tasks.title: runbook section for reading a background run
tasks.acceptance: GOAL_RUNBOOK.md documents the ledger fields and the four stop codes; the doc-consistency test asserts each string; full node suite and release_gate --clean-clone pass
